column1: # SoC ID -> Wi-Fi chip name, for SNOC/icnss devices that have no PCI ID.
# Format: <soc_id><TAB><chip_name>. One soc_id per line (aliases from the
# original grouped `case` entries, e.g. "317|318)", are expanded to two rows).
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Wi-Fi chip per SoC sourced from Qualcomm product pages and kernel DT files.
# NOTE: SoC ID 394 is intentionally NOT listed here — it is ambiguous between
# SDM665/Trinket and SD732G/Lagoon and requires disambiguation by machine name.
# That special case is still handled directly in backend.sh (get_driver_info).
# ── (394 = SDM665/Trinket or SD732G/Lagoon — handled in backend.sh) ──
